summary: Avoid rehashing the final replication inventory bucket when only graph or projection state changes.

replay.detail: No startup replay or history rewrite.

schema.detail: No stored table, index or migration changes; the terminal SHA256 prefix is an in-memory cache only.

rules.detail: No claim admission, ordering, checkpoint or retention changes.

compatibility.detail: Inventory digest bytes and replication wire messages are unchanged. Snapshots with unchanged envelope inventory retain the completed digest rather than hashing the final bucket again.

manual.detail: Normal binary upgrade; no state conversion.

recovery.detail: Existing inventory mutation tracking and full rebuild behavior remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary daemon restart. Real macOS load reduction has not been measured.
